messages:
jane.cs: Heads-up — AcmeCorp reports SSO started failing right after their IdP rotated certs. They get a 403 at our ACS and say log shows 'Signature verification failed: no matching key'. They also mentioned the IdP metadata now serves with Content-Encoding: br and charset=UTF-16.

mike.eng: thanks — forwarding their raw metadata link. looks suspicious that our metadata fetcher might not be handling brotli + utf-16. can you paste the fetch logs? @eli.sre any known regressions in metadata parser?

eli.sre: I pulled logs from metadata-poller for that tenant:
```
GET /idp/metadata.xml 200 OK
response headers: content-encoding: br; content-type: application/saml+xml; charset=utf-16
decompress error: invalid header
parser: failed to parse as utf-8
```
So poller failed and fell back to cached (old) metadata -> signature key mismatch after rotation.

aj.support: Customer says they rotated the signing cert and set the new KeyDescriptor as signing. Their IdP vendor was supposed to publish uncompressed UTF-8 metadata but the pipeline added brotli + utf-16. They included a manual metadata upload to our portal, which worked, but automatic repro triggered failures.

mike.eng: repro plan: 1) reproduce fetch with curl (simulate brotli + utf-16) 2) confirm poller rejects compressed/utf-16 content 3) add graceful fallback to attempt decompress+transcode before parsing.

eli.sre: quick curl I ran:
```
curl -sI https://idp.acme.example/metadata | sed -n '1,5p'
HTTP/2 200\ncontent-encoding: br\ncontent-type: application/saml+xml; charset=UTF-16
```
Then `curl --compressed` fails because client lib expects utf-8 decode after decompression.

saml-bot: noted incident created: INC-2026-1123 (auto) — assigned to mike.eng and eli.sre.

aj.support: Customer workaround: they uploaded the UTF-8 copy into our tenant metadata UI and SSO started working immediately. They asked why auto-refresh didn't pick it up.

mike.eng: root cause hypothesis: metadata-poller uses http client that honors content-encoding but assumes content is utf-8 post-decompress. If server advertises utf-16 we currently abort. We should try: decompress -> detect BOM/charset -> transcode -> parse. I'll push a small patch to the poller to attempt transcode and add better logging.

eli.sre: also adding retry logic: if parse fails and cached metadata present, trigger an alert rather than silently using old cached metadata — that avoids silent auth break for long-running cached keys.

aj.support: I'm telling the customer: short-term keep manual upload, we are patching poller and will deploy within 4 hours. Also asked them to serve metadata as UTF-8 without brotli.

mike.eng: patch pushed to staging, unit tests added for brotli+utf-16 case and an end-to-end integration with a sample IdP gzip/brotli variants. Deploy ETA: 2h to canary, 4h to prod assuming no regressions.

eli.sre: post-deploy actions: run metadata-poller test harness across top 50 tenants to catch other malformed combos. I'll signal ops-runbook to monitor SSO 5xx/sec.

aj.support: thanks — will keep AcmeCorp updated. Adding note to ticket: ask customers to avoid non-UTF-8 metadata or ensure Content-Encoding matches actual encoding.

mike.eng: follow-up: filed a small doc in #eng-runtime about "metadata poller charset handling" and linked the fix PR. I'll post the PR link here when CI green. :thumbsup:

jane.cs: perfect — customer very relieved. closing initial escalation once prod rollout complete and AcmeCorp confirms.
